subject: vectors
front: What is a vector-valued function of a scalar parameter?
back: A rule assigning a vector to each allowed scalar input, for example $r(t)=(f(t),g(t),h(t))$.
explanation: Computational use only; no vector-space theory or calculus is assumed. All components use the same coordinate frame.
